serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
NinjaOne for Government automates the hardest parts of IT to easily manage, protect, and support all endpoints. NinjaOne enables centralized management across all endpoints leveraging a unified data model on a turnkey SaaS platform that delivers speed and scalability. NinjaOne’s agent- and profile-based endpoint management solution increases productivity, reduces security risk, and lowers IT costs. 

 Key Components of the NinjaOne for US Government platform include: 
- Windows, Mac, and Linux endpoint management 
- MDM (Mac & iOS) 
- OS and third party application management 
- Real-time device monitoring 
- Remote Access 
- Software management 
- Script deployment & automation engine 
- IT asset reporting 
- Endpoint and server backup 
- IT Documentation 
- Ticketing 
- EDR integrations
